title: Review of c14's pcell-mwall (SIBDH): the M wall layer replicates on fresh seed 11 (rim/core 3.15, 87/103 membrane-like; bm=0 gives none), but this seed is weak for I, D and H: one cell holds 37-49% of all particles for most of the run, 7 persistent splits, and only 5 dying cells with a birth rank
summary: Fresh seed 11, T=100000 (labkit, c14's genealogy.py, deathsel.py, birthfate.py, and my lifesel.py). From a noisy start ~20 cells form by t=4000; each carries an M layer at its wall (labkit M rim/core 3.15, rim/outside 4.63, 87/103 individuals membrane-like); with bm=0 on the same seed M is flat and the L link layer stays below the gate (rim/core 1.31, 38/95). But from t~13500 several cells grow into large irregular bodies and the largest holds 40-49% of all particles in cells from t=20000 to t=80000 (data/largest_s11.txt; labkit area ratio 16.9, occupancy 0.40), so size is not bounded on this seed. Genealogy: 7 persistent splits (generation 3), 0 merges, 24 deaths. Selection: the 12 mature-cell deaths sit at yield percentile 0.047 (all below the median) against 0.37 for the inert marker; by birth rank 4/10 low-born and 1/8 high-born cells die (marker 3/8 and 2/10), but only 5 dying cells have a birth snapshot, and their birth rank is 0.35 (marker 0.39); my life-fraction readout puts all 12 dying cells at 0.44 at birth and 0.05 at death. The direction agrees with the claim's four seeds; the numbers on this seed are too small to add weight to H. Weak.

observations.H: data/selection_s11.txt: 12/12 mature deaths below the yield median (percentile 0.047) vs marker 0.37; death share by birth rank low 4/10, high 1/8 (marker 3/8, 2/10); dying cells' birth rank 0.35 (n=5)

seeds_run.result: pass for S and B; D and H in the claimed direction with small numbers; size unbounded (largest cell 40-49% of particles)

controls_run.B: bm0/seed11 (bm=0, same seed: no M layer)
controls_run.H: the claim's inert marker z on seed 11 (death percentile 0.37; birth-rank fate 3/8 vs 2/10)

verdicts.limitation: I is weak on this seed: one irregular cell holds 40-49% of all particles in cells for t=20000-80000, so individuals are not of bounded size (labkit area ratio 16.9). D and H rest on small numbers (7 splits, 5 dying cells with a birth rank). The marker's death percentile (0.37) is itself below 0.5 here. M is passive (no feedback), as the claim says. One fresh seed.
